graph_state.fountain_script:
Title: Episode S01E01: The Azimuth Signal
Credit: Written by
Author: VideoStudio Multi-Agent Pipeline
Draft date: Episode S01E01

====
INT. HELIOS DEEP-SPACE OBSERVATORY DOME - NIGHT

Sleet lashes the curved glass of the observatory dome. Commander Elena Vance rotates the brass azimuth vernier until the green CRT waveform stabilizes.

ELENA VANCE
(eyes fixed on the oscilloscope, jaw set; low, measured urgency)
That carrier wave is repeating on a seven-second harmonic. Unseal the Chrono-Compass.

Dr. Marcus Koren steps into the amber console light, adjusting his titanium spectacles as he unlatches the brass compass casing.

DR. MARCUS KOREN
(glancing toward the pressure bulkhead; guarded, hesitant)
If we route that harmonic through Sub-Level Four, the Directorate sensors will register the spike.

> CUT TO:

INT. SUB-LEVEL 4 CRYOGENIC RELAY VAULT - NIGHT

Cryogenic vapor pours across the grated basalt floor of the vault. Elena presses the opened Chrono-Compass into the recessed waveguide socket.

ELENA VANCE
(breath misting in the cold, brow furrowed; resolute)
The phase lock holds. Read me the origin coordinates before the frost blinds the primary optics.

Sparks arc across the conduit manifold, leaving a scorch mark along Elena's right forearm sleeve as Koren braces the terminal.

DR. MARCUS KOREN
(eyes widening behind fogged lenses; stunned realization)
It isn't an echo. Beacon Nine is broadcasting live from inside the Jovian shadow.

> DISSOLVE TO:

INT. SUB-LEVEL 4 CRYOGENIC RELAY VAULT - NIGHT

Amber containment beacons spin along the vault ceiling. Elena pulls the scorched Chrono-Compass free and engages the uplink lever as the blast doors begin to close.

ELENA VANCE
(flinching against the sodium glare, resolute; commanding)
Telemetry packet transmitted. Move—through the upper hatch now!

> FADE OUT:
